Description.Name: Grol
Description.Details:
David "Grol" Avellar became the 13th President of the Outworlds Alliance after his mother, Allyce Avellar was forced to step down. Both a skillful politician and mechwarrior, he assumed the presidency during a tumultuous period for the Outworlds Alliance. He personally fought in several campaigns to resist the invasions of both the New Delphi Compact and Clan Ghost Bear. 

During the Ghost Bear invasion Avellar was mortally wounded, only surviving due to an experimental nanomachine treatment engineered by ComStar. The treatment left him heavily disfigured, only regaining his former appearance after undergoing advanced facial reconstruction supplied by Clan Snow Raven. 

The years of conflict took their toll on Avellar's psyche, and after being indoctrinated by a Snow Raven psyops program he developed unstable personality traits. He ultimately led a doomed campaign against Clan Wolf to seize Terra, leading former ally Kurita to break their alliance and attack Avellar's forces. Avellar then turned his ire on his former allies, wreaking a swath of destruction through Kuritan space before ultimately being stopped one jump short of the Draconis Combine capital of Luthien. After these failed campaigns he disappeared, with Clan Snow Raven taking control of former Outworlds Alliance territory. His ultimate fate is still unknown.
